name: table-api-keys
title: API keys and permissions
description: API keys and permissions. MDX/Table pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/mdx/Table and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.

files.content:
import { Badge } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Pill'; import { default as Button } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Button'; import { CardRoot as Card, CardContent } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Card'; import { TableRoot as Table, TableBodyPrimitive as TableBody, TableCellPrimitive as TableCell, TableHeadPrimitive as TableHead, TableHeader, TableRowPrimitive as TableRow } from '@gaudi/design-system/mdx/Table'; import { RegistryIcon } from '@gaudi/design-system/icons/RegistryIcon'; const apiKeys = [ { name: 'Production API', token: 'sk_live_\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u20224f3a', permissions: ['read', 'write'], lastUsed: '2 minutes ago', status: 'Active', statusVariant: 'success-light' }, { name: 'Staging API', token: 'sk_test_\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u20228b2c', permissions: ['read', 'write', 'admin'], lastUsed: '1 hour ago', status: 'Active', statusVariant: 'success-light' }, { name: 'CI/CD Pipeline', token: 'sk_ci_\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u20221d9e', permissions: ['read'], lastUsed: '3 days ago', status: 'Active', statusVariant: 'success-light' }, { name: 'Legacy Integration', token: 'sk_old_\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u2022\u20227a5f', permissions: ['read', 'write'], lastUsed: '30 days ago', status: 'Expired', statusVariant: 'destructive-light' } ]; const permissionVariant = { read: 'outline', write: 'info-light', admin: 'warning-light' }; export function Pattern() { return ( Name Key Permissions Status Actions {apiKeys.map((key) => (
{key.name} Last used: {key.lastUsed}
{key.token}
{key.permissions.map((perm) => ( {perm} ))}
{key.status}
))}
); }
